text.p: MaxServ Inc said on Tuesday that Sears, Roebuck and Co's $7.00 a share takeover offer is inadequate and urged shareholders to reject the proposal.
"Proposed consideration of $7.00 in cash is inadequate to the MaxServ shareholders other than Sears," MaxServ said in a statement.

MaxServ said a special committee of the company's board of directors reviewed the deal and received a written opinion from its financial advisor, Broadview Associates LLC, that led to the decision to reject the offer from Sears.
Sears said on February 4 that it had launched its first hostile takeover bid to buy the 35.6 percent of MaxServ that it does not already own for about $27 million.
MaxServ said its special committee will continue to negotiate with Sears to attempt to get a higher offer for the company's shares.
